IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Prompt: What do you say into the radio?
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_NotEquipped: Hold the walkie-talkie in your hand or wear the radio on your back: no transmitting from your belt or inventory.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Reject_NoRadio: You need a two-way radio: in your hand or on your back (not on your belt), set down nearby or in your vehicle.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Reject_TooFar: Get closer to the radio's microphone.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Reject_NotInVehicle: Get in the vehicle to use its radio.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Reject_Cooldown: Give him a moment to answer.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Reject_Busy: Too much chatter on the frequency, try again later.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Reject_Spam: You keep talking: catch your breath before the next call.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Call: Anyone out there? This is Walt, I got out of Knox. I'm listening on %1. Over.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Call_Darlene: Darlene here, on watch. Anyone hurt or sick out there, call me on %1 and I'll talk you through it. Over.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Call_Cody: Anyone on this band? Don't say your name, don't say where you are. You want to know where the soldiers are, I'm on %1. Over.
IGUI_RadioSurvivor_Call_Gus: Anyone in the zone with something to trade? I buy what the dead left behind. Serious people only, on %1. Over.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_Open: Good evening, Knox County. This is the Night Owl with the confirmed news of the day.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_None: Nothing confirmed reached me today. No news is good news, friends.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_More: And %1 more reports I can't read you tonight.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_Close: Keep your doors shut and your radios on. Night Owl, signing off. Over.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_Memorial: One more thing. The names of those we lost today, so that somebody says them:
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_Mission_success: A job for %1 was carried out, %2.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_Mission_abandoned: A job for %1 was given up, %2.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_PowerCut: The power grid went down across the county.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_WaterCut: The taps ran dry across the county.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_Weather_storm: A thunderstorm broke over the county.
IGUI_RS_Bulletin_Weather_tropical_storm: A tropical storm hit the county.
IGUI_RS_ReportRadio: Objective met: call %1 back on its frequency and announce it. The mission succeeds only then; the deadline still runs.
IGUI_RS_ScoutReachedRadio: Place reached (%1). Report to the voice on its frequency.
IGUI_RS_ScoutReportRadio: Report: once the place has been reached, call the voice back on its frequency and tell it what you saw.
IGUI_RS_RetrieveDropCard: Leave the card taken from the body at one of the drop points below. Only that card is collected; any other ID card stays where it is.
IGUI_RS_RescueSee: I can see you from the window! You are %1. Come on, quickly!
IGUI_RS_RescueSeeGroup: I can see several of you from the window, %1. Come on, quickly!
IGUI_RS_RescueSeeVehicle: I can see a vehicle out there, %1. Is that you?
IGUI_RS_RescueSmoke_green: I can hear you out there! I am lighting a green smoke outside, follow it.
IGUI_RS_RescueSmoke_red: I can hear you out there! I am lighting a red smoke outside, follow it.
IGUI_RS_RescueSmoke_yellow: I can hear you out there! I am lighting a yellow smoke outside, follow it.
IGUI_RS_RescueSmoke_purple: I can hear you out there! I am lighting a purple smoke outside, follow it.
IGUI_RS_RescueNote_Text:
To %1,

You came for us in time. We will never forget it.

We are leaving this place for somewhere safer. We left you what we could spare.

We will keep listening on the radio.

%2
IGUI_RS_RescueLast_Waited: We called for help on the radio. We waited %1 days.
IGUI_RS_RescueLast_WaitedOne: We called for help on the radio. We waited a whole day.
IGUI_RS_RescueLast_Group: There were %1 of us in here.
IGUI_RS_RescueLast_Approach: Once we saw someone come close. They did not stay.
IGUI_RS_RescueLast_Delivered: Someone left us food. It kept us going a little longer, but it was not enough.
IGUI_RS_RescueLast_End: The food is gone and we are too weak to leave. If you find this, we waited as long as we could.
IGUI_RS_PersonalTrustSeparate: Each person you know also has their own opinion of you, apart from this reputation:
IGUI_RS_RepReason_RequesterKilled: Killed %1, who had entrusted you with a mission
IGUI_RS_NotApplied: Confirmed event, contribution not applied: API unavailable
IGUI_RS_SelectHint: Ctrl+G: nearest visible NPC. Configurable in Options.
IGUI_RS_Incident_maintain: %1 keeps the agreement despite the incident
IGUI_RS_Incident_repair: %1 keeps the agreement but demands %2 as reparation
IGUI_RS_Incident_break: %1 broke the agreement after the incident
IGUI_RS_Empty_Radio: No radio conversation yet. Talk into a two-way radio or listen: what your radios receive is noted here.
IGUI_RS_RadioNoEquipped: Hold a radio in your hands or wear it on your back to tune it.
IGUI_RS_RadioOutOfRange: %1 MHz is out of this radio's range (%2 to %3 MHz).
IGUI_RS_LastPages_Days: I have held on for %1 days and %2 hours since it all began.
IGUI_RS_LastPages_Kills: I have put down %1 of the dead.
IGUI_RS_LastPages_KillsNone: I have not had to kill any of them.
IGUI_RS_LastPages_TownsNone: I never got far from where I started.
IGUI_RS_LastPages_Missions: I took on jobs for other survivors: %1 done, %2 failed, %3 dropped.
IGUI_RS_LastPages_Open: I never finished what I promised to %1.
IGUI_RS_LastPages_OpenNoName: I never finished one last job.
IGUI_RS_LastPages_Rescues: I saved %1 people, and could not save %2.
IGUI_RS_LastPages_Radio: My last words on the radio:
IGUI_RS_LastPages_End: Whoever finds this: these were my last pages.

IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cancel_patrol: No run tonight. A patrol boat is working the river. Stay off the bank. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cancel_helicopter: No run tonight. A helicopter is sweeping the river. Keep your heads down. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cancel_storm: No run tonight. There is a storm on the river, no boat crosses in that. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cancel_late: I waited at the landing and nobody showed the signal. I am gone. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Done: Your goods are in the bag on the landing. Pleasure doing business. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cheated: You tried to short me. Your bag stays where it is, no deal, and I will remember it. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cancel_nodrop: Nobody left me a bag at the landing. I am gone. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cancel_late_road: I pulled over and nobody showed the signal. I am gone. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Done_road: Your goods are in the bag by the road. Pleasure doing business. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cancel_nodrop_road: Nobody left me a bag by the road. I am gone. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cancel_checkpoint: No run tonight. The army put a checkpoint on the road. Stay off it. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cancel_air_patrol: No run tonight. A helicopter is flying over the roads. I am not driving under it. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cancel_washout: No run tonight. The storm has the roads under water. I am staying put. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cancel_late_cache: My runner went by the cache and found nothing to take. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Done_cache: Your goods are in the cache. Take them when nobody is looking. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cheated_cache: You tried to short me. Your payment stays in the cache, no deal, and I will remember it. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cancel_nodrop_cache: My runner found the cache empty. No deal this time. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cancel_sweep: Nothing tonight. Soldiers are sweeping the streets. Leave the cache alone. Over.
IGUI_RS_TradeRun_Cancel_overflight: Nothing tonight. A helicopter is circling the town. My runner stays home. Over.
IGUI_RS_DeadDropApproach: Approach a marked drop point first and wait for the notebook to confirm it before leaving any goods there.
IGUI_RS_DeadDropPoints: Drop points, at your choice (deliveries at several points add up): %1.
IGUI_RS_DeadDropBox: Where a container was designated, leave the goods in it. The container stays there.
IGUI_RS_DeadDropBag: Where no container was designated, leave a bag on the ground. Put only requested goods inside: the whole bag will be collected.
IGUI_RS_DeadDropLeave: The collector stays hidden: a drop point is emptied only when nobody is within sight of it (about 100 tiles), about %1 game hours after the last person left. Coming back in sight before that restarts the wait. Until collection, you may take the delivery back.
IGUI_RS_DeadDropCollected: The delivery has been collected. Report back to the requester on the radio.
IGUI_RS_Reward_cache: I left supplies for you at the marked place.
IGUI_RS_Reward_frequency: A radio contact has been added to your notebook.
IGUI_RS_Reward_stashmap: You received an annotated map to a stash.
